title: Math Skills for the Professional Baker

program.section_heading: Math Skills for the Professional Baker - Certificate of Competency - CC8026
outcomes: Convert basic fractions to decimals, and decimals to fractions.
Understand how to use a digital scale, and process the results as a recipe measurement.
Understand basic cost control terminology and calculations.
Understand Baker’s Percentages as they are written on recipes.
Using Baker’s Percentages to calculate new recipe yields based on actual quantities needed.
Understand the basic components and importance of a standardized recipe.
Understand what SPECS sheets are, and how they affect menu pricing.
Understand how to calculate a menu price after costing out a recipe from start to completion.

notes: The catalog titles this award a Certificate of Competency (CC8026), a noncredit award counted in hours. All units fields therefore hold hours.
Course codes are printed with a hyphen (CUL-875 etc.). They match closed-list codes CUL 875-878.
Every course is marked '( Historical )' in the catalog, which may mean the courses are inactive or being retired. A reviewer should check that the program is current for 2026-2027.
The heading 'Math Skills for the Professional Baker - Certificate of Competency - CC8026' is printed twice at the top of the text.
